title: fix(terminal): coerce string notify true/false (#123345)
claim: terminal(background=true, notify=<bool-ish string>) must map recognized true/false tokens onto notify_on_complete instead of failing with 'notify must be true/false', while unrecognized values stay fail-closed.

evidence.source: Need is real on main: tools/terminal_tool.py:_handle_terminal (L1602-1613) only accepts isinstance(notify,bool)/list; tools/arg_coercion.coerce_tool_args skips props without a top-level 'type' (notify is anyOf boolean|array), so a string 'true' reaches the handler. Probe through real coerce_tool_args+_handle_terminal on main: {'background':'true','notify':'true'} -> background coerced to True, notify stays 'true' -> error 'notify must be true/false ...'; foreground {'notify':'false'} -> wrongly refused with 'notify/heartbeat only apply to background commands'.
evidence.red: fork test tests/tools/test_terminal_notify_coerce.py on main: 12 failed / 9 passed, e.g. AssertionError: {'error': 'notify must be true/false (notify on exit) or a list of strings (notify on output pattern match).'} for notify='true'/'false'/'1'/'yes'/'on'/' True '.
evidence.green: fork fix rebuilt on main (one trivial conflict: heartbeat error text drift) -> 21/21 fork tests + 2 dispatch-path probes pass (23 passed).
evidence.negative_control: disabling the str branch of _coerce_notify_arg -> 15 failed (13 fork tests + 2 probes).
evidence.adjacent: with fork fix: test_terminal_notify_coerce, test_process_heartbeat, test_watch_patterns, test_notify_on_complete, test_terminal_tool, tests/agent/test_tool_arg_coercion -> 90 passed, 0 failed.
evidence.external_cross_check: Fork tests run against external fixes applied to main: #123448 (WYSTAF) -> 20 passed / 3 failed: dispatch probe 'foreground notify="false" is a no-op' still refused (it coerces AFTER the foreground truthiness gate, and arg_coercion still skips notify), plus numeric 2 / 1.5 accepted (deliberate design choice in #123448, not a defect). #123356 (webtecnica, needs a one-line rebase for heartbeat message drift) -> 23/23 pass because its arg_coercion union fix coerces before the handler.
